name: Another World
source:
Welcome to Another World - an adult, slice-of-life visual novel centred around Arvin, alongside his many friends and acquaintances. Get to know each of the 10 main characters as they each play their part within this world, and build your relationships with each one!

Just remember, though - nothing is ever as it seems.
